prompt: What song topped Billboard magazine's Top 30 chart in the same year that the first documented case of a person being hit and surviving a meteorite occurred?
answer: The song was **“Little Things Mean a Lot” by Kitty Kallen**, which topped Billboard’s 1954 year-end chart—the same year Ann Hodges survived being struck by a meteorite in Sylacauga, Alabama.
